name: Scandit MCP
description: Set up Scandit barcode and ID scanning in coding agents: sign in, provision trial license keys and write them into your project's .env through a hosted MCP server.

skills.name: Scanner Setup
skills.description: Creates or reuses a trial subscription, project and license key for the chosen Scandit product and platforms in one idempotent call.

skills.name: Trial License Keys
skills.description: Adds or reuses an extra key on an existing trial for another app identifier, platform or web domain.

skills.name: List License Keys
skills.description: Lists license keys across every subscription the account can access, as masked previews that never expose a usable key.

skills.name: Write Key to .env
skills.description: Returns a one-line command that writes a license key into the project's .env file without showing the key in the chat.
